detail.title: Probing the Neurodiversity Paradigm vs. Clinical Pathology
detail.summary: Continued evaluation of the neurodiversity paradigm. The current notebook synthesis is limited to bibliographic metadata, which is insufficient to contrast the conceptual frameworks of clinical pathology and the neurodiversity paradigm effectively. Research is refocused on identifying substantive comparative analysis or definitional sources that move beyond metadata.
